The ground-floor south door occupies the +1.0 m bay with a full plain bay to its left and the corner pillar flush on its right. Visually this reads as a **plausible narrow medieval tower**, not as an obvious kit mis-assembly or SG-7 fail. Stone materials, door trim, and proportions are coherent with the square building and the procedural brick tower.
